title: Ball Match
description: Connect chains of matching colorful spheres to pop clusters, trigger bombs, and hit each stage target within limited moves.
controls: Drag across adjacent balls of the same color to link and pop them before moves run out.

zh-CN.title: 球球消消乐
zh-CN.description: 连线消除同色立体彩球，触发炸弹与连击特效，在限定步数内完成每关收集目标。
zh-CN.controls: 按住并滑动连接相邻同色彩球，松手即可连线消除，善用炸弹道具过关。
